mainEntity.name: What role does AI play in home remodeling and renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can quickly test different layout and material scenarios, refine cost estimates, and simulate design options for kitchens, extensions, multigenerational layouts, and whole-home remodels so you can make more informed decisions.
